title: Marketplace Spotlight Tile Guidelines and Acceptance Gates
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a focused working draft for the Marketplace "Spotlight" tile — concise creative guidance, three short copy variants for A/B, and an acceptance gate checklist combining product/technical/security checks. Aim: reduce last-minute rework during partner submissions and accelerate review handoffs.

Context / scope notes (working):
- 'Spotlight' tile = marketplace first-screen featured card (90–120 char headline + 2–3 line blurb and 1 CTA).
- Audience: Platform buyers evaluating Redwood Hosted API + Dedicated packages (SMB mid-market).
- This doc sits upstream of the canonical listing docs; use it for quick creative sign-off and preflight QA.

Quick creative constraints (hard):
- Title: max 60 characters (truncate-friendly).
- Short description: 110–140 characters (mobile readable).
- Long description: 500–800 characters (SEO + features).
- Hero image: 1200x628px or square 800x800; include transparent PNG for overlays.
- Logo: 600x600 PNG, safe zone 40px.
- No pricing claims in tile headline (pricing belongs in billing section).

Spotlight tile copy — Variant A (technical-first):
- Headline: "High-performance LLM inference — predictable latency"
- Short blurb: "Run optimized LLM endpoints with SLO-backed latency, autoscaling pools, and token-level cost insights."
- CTA: "Try hosted API"

Variant B (business benefit):
- Headline: "Ship AI features with production-grade inference"
- Short blurb: "Deliver fast, cost-effective LLM responses across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
- CTA: "Start free trial"

Variant C (concise & PLG-friendly):
- Headline: "Inference that scales with your app"
- Short blurb: "Same API, predictable cost — from dev prototypes to enterprise deployments."
- CTA: "Get started"

Microcopy notes (bullets to include in longer listing):
- One-line feature bullets (max 6):
  - SLA-backed dedicated capacity
  - Prefix/KV caching reduces token costs
  - Model catalog & verified perf profiles
  - Smart routing & automatic fallbacks
  - Built-in observability & token-level breakdowns
  - Private deployment options (VPC/on-prem)

Acceptance gates (pre-publish checklist) — reviewers: product, infra, security, legal, GTM dev: 
- Product signoff:
  - [ ] Short + long descriptions approved (product_marketing PR link)
  - [ ] Feature bullets match catalog metadata ID
- Technical acceptance:
  - [ ] Endpoint reachable from marketplace test account (smoke account)
  - [ ] Sample API key + SDK example included in listing assets
  - [ ] Performance claim validation: 50% tile claims must reference the perf-profile ID in model catalog
  - [ ] Helm/packaging artifacts for Private flow attached (if listing advertises on-prem)
- Billing / legal:
  - [ ] SKU mapping to Redwood pricing ledger complete (finance SLA)
  - [ ] Data processing description for marketplace buyers present (PII handling)
- Security & compliance gates:
  - [ ] KMS/HSM integration noted where required
  - [ ] Audit-log retention & access controls documented
  - [ ] Verified that no sample data embedded in screenshots contains customer PII
  - [ ] Pen-test/third-party attestation (if enterprise checkbox is used) attached

QA flow (test matrix, suggestions):
- Smoke test (manual, 20 min):
  1) Use marketplace test user -> subscribe to free-tier SKU -> generate token -> call /v1/completions with example prompt -> validate 200 + latency < configured SLO for tile variant.
  2) Verify response stream works (if streaming advertised).
  3) Confirm logs in observability (route -> model -> token-cost) appear in console.
- Integration test (automation):
  - [ ] CI job that hits listing URL and validates asset presence (logo, hero image, short blurb).
  - [ ] End-to-end billing event simulated via sandbox merchant (JIRA-1290).

Design QA checklist (assets):
- [ ] All images in final RGB, sRGB color profile.
- [ ] No text smaller than 12px in hero imagery.
- [ ] Accessibility: 4.5:1 contrast for headline overlay.
- [ ] Provide alt text for image assets (one-line).

Launch playbook snippet (owners & timing):
- Two-week preflight: content freeze 7 days before publish.
- Stakeholders: PM (Asha Menon), Designer (Marcus Chen), Security (Elena Park), Finance (Rowan Patel), GTM ops (Lina Gomez).
- Day-of tasks: validate tile in staging, run smoke tests, confirm SKU & metering, push listing, monitor first 24h telemetry for errors.

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Does Marketplace require a separate privacy blurb for EU buyers? (legal: @Elena)
- Confirm whether 'Try hosted API' CTA maps to sign-up flow or direct provisioning flow in Azure marketplace — different behavior must be reflected in copy.
- Decide canonical perf-profile ID for the headline "predictable latency" claim (linked_artifact JIRA-1422).

References / links (working):
- Confluence listing pattern: https://confluence.redwood/marketplace/listing-patterns
- Perf profiles table: https://confluence.redwood/infra/perf-profiles
- Sandbox billing merchant: JIRA-1290

Notes: keep iterations short. This doc is a lightweight gate that should remove ambiguity for partners during submission and make reviewer responsibilities explicit. Replace sample copy with partner-specific language during submission; preserve the creative constraints and acceptance gates.
